content.text:
Built a complete, playable tank arena game in `index.html`. It features four starting tank classes, rival tank types, destructible shapes, XP and leveling, upgrade points, escalating waves, a radar, dash, and mobile touch controls.

The game uses a self-contained canvas with an isometric, 3D-styled look rather than a 3D engine. I syntax-checked the JavaScript and checked the game in desktop and mobile browser layouts.
